Disposition: MJ Stroud RETURNS (portal-None, Athlon headliner); Chance Gamble + Ty Furnish yr4-returns (Athlon starters); Omari/OJ Arnold GONE (draft prospect; feed name-mismatch dodged the yr4 gate).

7-6 with a lopsided '25 profile: a solid, well-blocked offense (as-played OFF p54, PBLK p91) but a HISTORICALLY bad defense (DEF p2, RDEF p0, PRSH p2 - dead last in FBS). New DC Mike Mutz (from SFA) is charged with the rebuild.

The offense loses its two biggest pieces: RB OJ Arnold (1,100 yds, to the draft) AND four starters off that p91 pass-blocking OL (Cook->USF, Brown->Louisville, Wright->Michigan State, Strong->North Texas). The RB becomes a homegrown committee (Mbadinga et al.); the OL rebuilds from within (Alexander/Furnish/Williams) + a transfer.

QB resets to veteran journeyman Max Johnson (UNC, a 6-year P4 starter - experienced but a modest 51.8 '25 grade) + frosh Weston Bryan (6 TD/49 snaps). WR reloads via P4 transfers (Hollins/Illinois, Noble Johnson/Arizona State) + injury-return Josh Dallas after losing 3 yr4 WRs.

Defense: edge MJ Stroud (74.5, All-SBC) is the one bright spot on a dead-last unit; most new arrivals are FCS (Mutz's SFA/Abilene Christian pipeline: Sears, Myles, Mangham). ST: K Tripp Bryant (16-16 inside 40, 2-5 beyond) + a transfer punter, off a '25 SPEC p13.
